throughput.reason: No trusted application load-test producer configured.
throughput.action: Add an approved synthetic application load-test collector; do not infer throughput from CI duration.

latency.action: Restore the pinned Lighthouse producer and its complete route reports.

availability.action: Configure an authenticated uptime collector and an explicit observation window.

privacy.reason: CI quality checks do not establish a production privacy assessment.
privacy.action: Add an independently reviewed privacy evidence producer; preserve the existing diagnostics allowlist.

accessibility.action: Restore the pinned Lighthouse producer and its complete route reports.

cost.action: Configure a trusted cost source; do not interpret missing billing as zero cost.

operationalReadiness.action: Run the pinned main-branch quality workflow, including contract, lint, test and build checks.

score.scope: Evidence coverage score, not a production health score; unavailable/invalid dimensions earn no points.
